title: Fix pre-existing ruff findings in backend test files
description: A full-repo `ruff check backend/` (not the narrower `ruff check app/` that static-verify/pr-reviewer/pr-decision have been running as their gated command all session) surfaces 7 pre-existing lint findings in test files, none introduced by any task worked this session -- they were repeatedly noticed and correctly judged out-of-scope by individual PR reviews (since none of those PRs touched these files), but never fixed or tracked as their own task, so they've kept resurfacing as noise in review after review. 6 are auto-fixable `I001` unsorted/unformatted import blocks (test_stooq_provider.py, test_autoenvelope.py, test_elder_ray.py, test_force_index.py, test_rsi.py, test_stochastic.py); 1 is a genuine `F841` unused local variable (`full_ohlcv` in test_triple_screen.py's `_weekly_ohlcv` truncation test, assigned but never read after a prior refactor). Also worth deciding: whether static-verify's own gated command (`ruff check app/`) should widen to include `tests/` too, so this class of drift gets caught going forward instead of only being noticed incidentally during PR reviews.

checklist.step: Run `ruff check backend/ --fix` to auto-fix the 6 unsorted-import findings; confirm no behavior change (tests still pass, coverage unaffected).

Fix the genuine F841 finding in test_triple_screen.py (either use `full_ohlcv` in an assertion it was clearly meant to support, or remove the now-dead assignment) -- read the surrounding test to determine which is correct, not just silence the warning.

Decide and record whether static-verify's gated ruff command should widen from `app/` to include `tests/`, so this class of drift is caught by the normal pipeline instead of only being noticed incidentally during PR reviews.
Confirm `ruff check backend/` (or backend/'s full test+app tree) is clean after the fix.
